title: Tapo T315
summary: Room temperature and humidity through a Tapo hub.
body:
## Pair with the hub

The documented setup uses a Tapo H200 hub. Pair the sensor with its hub, then configure the TP-Link/Tapo integration in Home Assistant.

## Verify readings

Confirm fresh temperature and humidity entities. Map them into the climate-air inputs and, if desired, Ramka’s climate page. No custom wiring is required for this sensor setup. Follow the model’s manufacturer instructions for battery installation and placement.

## Setup references

- [TP-Link Smart Home and hub-attached sensors — Home Assistant](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/tplink/)

These upstream instructions may evolve; the component versions and pinned source above record the DomoSenso scope.
